modelStorage.title: Model storage location
modelStorage.confirmDescription: Existing Vyact models will move to the dedicated models folder shown below. Future downloads will use this location, and any running model will be reloaded. Other files in the parent folder will stay in place.
modelStorage.desktopOnly: Change the storage location in the desktop app.
modelStorage.nested_storage_path: Choose a folder outside the current storage folder and its parents.
modelStorage.storage_not_empty: The destination models folder contains existing files. Choose another location. The embeddings folder in the default model location can remain in place.
modelStorage.storage_unavailable: The current model location is unavailable. Connect the drive and try again.
modelStorage.storage_links_unsupported: The model folder contains symbolic links or unsupported files.
modelStorage.storage_space: The selected drive does not have enough free space.
modelStorage.storage_verification: File verification failed. Original models are preserved.
modelStorage.storage_failed: Storage operation failed. Check the path and permissions, then try again.
modelStorage.storage_busy: Wait for responses, downloads, or model operations to finish, then try again.
modelStorage.storage_cleanup: Models moved, but some old files could not be removed.
modelStorage.storage_reload: Models moved, but reloading failed. Select the model again.
